islands.rule: whole position-connected islands lying inside the box min [-0.01,-0.03,-0.32] max [0.01,0.035,0.15] (m)

scale.rule: each vertex moved across X about the plate's LOCAL mid-surface (the centre of the selection's X extent within 0.004 m in y / z: both faces) by max(1, 0.0028 / the local thickness): the plate becomes ~2.8 mm thick where it was thinner, never thinner; normals by the inverse transpose

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane); y = the middle of a ray along Y through the cross-section at z (the handle axis)

Tip.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it
